title: Return the Apprentice
description: Perrin is out, and quiet in a way he wasn't before he left. Take him back to his master in Thornfield and let the wizard judge what's left of him - and what he owes him for refusing to teach it in the first place.

objectives.description: Bring Perrin back to his master in Thornfield

notes: Closing beat. The wizard's own refusal is what sent Perrin south; that guilt is prose only here, no branch lets the player raise it with him. Recorded as a second path this pass could not wire.
